name: spiral-text
title: Spiral Text
description: Text set on a responsive spiral that tightens under pressure and ripples on release.

useCases: Decorative spiral typography with pointer interaction.
limitations: A decorative text composition, not a reading paragraph or changing-label effect.
requirements: Supply text and room for the responsive spiral, and a pause control for the rotation. Requires Motion. Reduced motion stops the rotation and answers a press with a fade.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/spiral-text.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
